characteristics.name: Special
characteristics.$text: Area Effect, Blast (2D3), Saturation, Slow Reload, Volatile (2+)

sharedRules.name: Hatred of Mankind
sharedRules.description: Ingulf may re-roll one Command dice per turn when facing a force containing Enforcers and/or GCPS.

sharedRules.name: Reinforced
sharedRules.description: A model with this special rule ignores suppression tokens when checking to see if the AP of a weapon ignores the shield or not. Note that whilst the number of suppression tokens equals or beats the shield value this rule has no effect.

sharedRules.name: Repair
sharedRules.description:
A unit with this special rule may take a short or long action to attempt to restore one lost resilience point on a friendly vehicle within 2". To do so roll a D6. On a 4+ the repair attempt has been successful, remove one point of damage from the target vehicle.
If the unit chooses to take a long action to do this repair they gain a +2 modifier to the repair roll
